descriptions.w3d_cc35b_movie_buffers_802e1134: Lays out a caller-supplied movie arena after original opened/playing/busy guards. Preserves unsigned width-height product, original 32-byte alignment, three plane cache operations, ten12-byte video slots and conditional four12-byte audio slots, per-slot state reloads and final end pointer.
